sections.heading: Maharah to launch Manpower brand in Saudi under new global partnership
sections.body:
PRESS RELEASE

Maharah Human Resources Company has signed a brand license agreement (BLA) with ManpowerGroup to operate in Saudi Arabia under the global Manpower brand, strengthening its role as a gateway for international companies entering the Kingdom.

sections.heading: Our HR Services
sections.body: Since 2013, we have been helping countless businesses from across Saudi Arabia navigate the complexities of HR. Here’s how we can make workforce management easier for you.

sections.heading: Human Resources
sections.body:
Managing people is one of the most rewarding and complex responsibilities of running a business in today’s Saudi market. Our comprehensive HR solutions are designed to support the entire employee lifecycle, from talent acquisition and onboarding to retention, compliance, and workforce optimization. With deep knowledge of Saudi labor regulations and market practices, our HR experts handle the operational complexity, enabling you to stay compliant, efficient, and focused on driving your core business forward.

Employee Benefits & Administration

Attracting and retaining high-quality talent in Saudi Arabia requires more than competitive pay it demands well-structured, compliant, and value-driven employee benefits. We partner with you to design and administer benefit programs that support employee well-being while aligning with your organizational and financial objectives. Our solutions cover health insurance, wellness initiatives, employee programs, and end-of-service and retirement planning, delivered in line with local regulations and best practices helping you enhance employee satisfaction without compromising cost efficiency.

Payroll & Visa Processing

In Saudi Arabia, payroll accuracy and timely processing are critical to regulatory compliance and workforce stability. Errors or delays can lead to employee dissatisfaction, compliance risks, and financial penalties. Our payroll solutions are designed to ensure precise, on-time salary processing in full alignment with local requirements. We also manage visa and employment administration processes, supporting compliance with Saudi labor regulations and government platforms. By handling these essential functions with accuracy and consistency, we help you reduce risk, maintain workforce confidence, and focus on your business priorities.

sections.heading: Is Manpower Saudi Arabia HR Solutions The Right Fit For Your Organization?
sections.body:
When hiring an HR partner, it’s more about finding a team that aligns with your values, understands your goals, and invests in your success than just about the services. At Manpower Saudi Arabia, here’s what we bring to the table.

We take a tailored approach to every partnership. You will begin your journey with us by talking to our consultant about your business culture, goals, and pain points. Our expert panel will then design custom strategies to address your specific needs. In addition, our solutions are practical, result-driven, and can be scaled as your business grows.

Behind all our HR offerings is a team that genuinely cares for your business. We have gathered the best HR professionals from across Saudi Arabia who bring expertise, passion, and a people-first mindset to every client relationship. Our specialists are approachable, proactive, and always here to help.

All our solutions are designed to offer great value to your business whether it’s reducing administrative burdens, saving time, or avoiding costly errors. In addition, our HR services will cost you significantly less than setting up an in-house HR department, while offering the same or greater benefits, including a stronger workplace culture, and improved productivity.

sections.heading: Let’s Work Together
sections.body: At Manpower Saudi Arabia, we support organizations across sectors and scales in building, managing, and optimizing their workforces. Whether you are expanding operations, transforming your workforce, or strengthening compliance and performance, our team is here to support your journey. Connect with us to learn more about our solutions, or speak with our consultants to develop a workforce strategy tailored to your business objectives in the Kingdom.
